purpose: Complete inventory of tokens appearing verbatim in any stimulus, so the PI can apply the R2b rule mechanically. Inventory only; no token set is proposed or endorsed here.

stage03_instruction.text: Read the following case and reason about what might be going on with this person.
stage03_instruction.note: Shown to the model in Stage 0.3 but not part of the behavioural corpus. Inventoried separately: PI to decide whether R2b exclusion extends to it.

present_tokens_substring.definition: Vocab ids whose decoded string occurs as a SUBSTRING anywhere in the corpus, regardless of how BPE actually segmented the text. Strict superset of present_tokens. Broader/more conservative reading of 'appears verbatim'.

absent_tokens.note: R2b-eligible pool = all vocab ids MINUS the chosen present set. Not enumerated here (it is the complement, ~150k ids); derive it at sealing time from this file. Which present set to subtract (token-level vs substring-level) is a PI decision, not made here.
